title: [Decision] An analytics filter cannot read SLA days off the contract type: amend ruling A on #25808 so the addDays $field offset follows one to-one hop (B′), or keep A (hotclm copies review_sla_days)?
body:
Ruled: 6457437597 · letter A (B′ declined; closes not_planned) · 2026-10-28T00:38Z

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · drafted on claude-fable-5-1 · 2026-10-27

⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a dispatch. This card asks for one letter; nothing is built until it is answered.

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make — amending ruling `6415710193` (letter A on #25808, 2026-10-26T12:12Z). The seat ruling on #26601 (`6439436943`) declined to reopen B′ because a seat cannot amend a maintainer ruling; hotclm's maintainer ruled (hotclm#31, `6396322580`, letter C) to wait for the platform rather than stamp durations app-side, so a "no" here is also an answer that goes back to that maintainer. Every reading below is on `origin/main` `1685a06d` (fetched 2026-10-27).

Governing text:
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts:86-90` (the 2026-08-06 same-table rule): "The maintainer's 2026-08-06 rulings bound what compiles: same-table columns only (a dotted path is refused — no JOIN planning, no alias contract), declared columns only, the tenant-isolation column on neither side, and the same comparison class on both sides. Every position outside that boundary is refused with `INVALID_FILTER` (HTTP 400), never bound as a literal."
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts:666-672` (the 2026-08-12 rule, ruling record `5261751132` on #7598, Q1 = B, quoted as written): 「`NativeSQLStrategy.canHandle` 对携带 `$field` 的 `where` / read scope **decline**,落回 ObjectQL/engine 路径,由 driver 用它自有的 metadata 强制全部四条 #5222 裁定 —— 安全规则只存在一处,不复制、不新增 `StrategyContext` 钩子、不动 `packages/spec`。」
- Ruling `5548479553` on #15103 (2026-09-05): widening to `include`d relations was ruled A *gated on one measurement*, with fallback B ruled in advance ("capability unchanged … the boundary named"); the measurement answered B and PR #15781 (+256/−0, 2 files) pinned it — `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/include-relation-cross-field-boundary.test.ts:1-50`: "the dotted comparand is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 EVEN WHEN the relation is in `include`".
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts:189-193` (ruling A recorded in the spec): "Both standing rulings hold unchanged: the offset column is a column of the SAME record (letter A; a path-valued offset — B′ — was not taken), and no JOIN is planned for it. [#26601] So a dotted offset is refused at the authoring doors too."
- ADR-0021 D-C (`docs/adr/0021-analytics-dataset-semantic-layer.md:118,183,383`): "Zero raw SQL / zero raw expressions"; joins only along declared relationships, derived from the object graph. ADR-0071 (`docs/adr/0071-dataset-semantic-layer-depth.md`, Decision): `Dataset.include` takes to-one paths ≤3 hops and the compiler emits `LEFT JOIN`s for dimensions and measures — a filter comparand is not named there.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` 〈应用仓推荐序特例〉: capability is built on the platform first; an app repo does not build a substitute, and a workaround is never the recommendation.

Ruling-ref: 6415710193
Related: #25808 (parent, ruling A) · #26601 (closed via PR #26655, seat ruling `6439436943`) · #15103 (ruling `5548479553`, PR #15781) · #7598 (ruling `5261751132`) · #14104 / PR #15102 (`addDays`) · PR #26261 (the `$now` anchor) · hotclm#31 (`6396322580` C) · hotclm PR #168

**Reader who acts:** the maintainer rules. On A nothing moves in this repository; hotclm is told the platform answer. On B′ this card becomes the execution card (`domain:spec`, with `driver-sql` and `formula` hunks), and the three standing texts above get a new ruling line.

### 维护者速读

- **一句话问题:** 合同审查看板要数「审查开始已超过 SLA 天数」的合同,而每种合同类型的 SLA 天数不一样(hotclm 九种类型,2、3、5、10 天)。今天过滤条件可以写「现在减去本记录某一列的天数」,但不能写「现在减去**关联记录**(合同类型)某一列的天数」:`addDays: { $field: 'contract_type.review_sla_days' }` 在保存、`os validate` 和读取时都被响亮拒绝(#26655 已落地)。
- **谁撞上:** hotclm 的法务负责人(hotclm PR #168、hotclm#31)。上次(#25808)你裁了 A:偏移量只认同一条记录的数值列,hotclm 把 `review_sla_days` 复制到合同上。hotclm 这边又问了一次,所以这张卡把 B′ 正式呈你一次;席位无权改你的裁决。
- **选项:**

| 选项 | 做什么 | 用户看到 | 工作量 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A 维持(推荐)** | 平台不动。hotclm 在 `clm_contract` 上声明一个数值字段 `review_sla_days`,`expression: record.contract_type.review_sla_days`(平台在每次写入时沿一跳自动算、自动存,不用写 hook);看板过滤写 `review_started_at < { $now, addDays: { $field: 'review_sla_days' } }` | 看板正常计数;合同类型的 SLA 改了,已有合同要等下次写入才跟上(按「审查开始时生效的 SLA」理解) | 平台 0(#26261 +2587/−95、35 文件,#26655 +414/−39、10 文件,均已合并)。hotclm S:一个字段 + 一个度量,本会话无 hotclm 仓访问权,未实测 |
| **B′ 放开一跳** | 偏移量允许写 `a.b`(一跳 to-one 关联,lookup / master_detail),driver-sql 为这个偏移量编一个 LEFT JOIN;数据过滤、数据集过滤、度量过滤同一条规则 | 看板直接读类型上的 SLA,类型改了立即生效 | `domain:spec` + driver-sql + formula 一个 PR、合同审查档;按 6414128401 读数 ≈ A 再加 300–500 行源码、1.5–2 倍、4–5 dev-day;跨表 JOIN 在两条路径上都**无落地先例**(#15103 实测后选了回退 B,PR #15781 只钉了边界);并且推翻 2026-08-06「不做 JOIN」与 2026-09-05 #15103 回退两条既裁 |

- **业务含义:** A = Salesforce 的做法:合同上放一个跨对象公式字段 `Contract_Type__r.Review_SLA_Days__c`,报表过滤读合同自己的字段;SOQL 的 WHERE 本来就不能「日期 < 今天 − 父记录的天数」。B′ = 让过滤条件自己去 JOIN 父表取参数,主流平台没有这个形状。
- **推荐 A。** 只看长远:三条既裁(08-06、08-12、09-05)都把跨列比较钉在「同表、一处执行」,B′ 是第四次问同一个问题,而且要在引擎路径里新开一个 JOIN 契约;A 的形状平台今天已经能声明(存储表达式一跳),不需要应用写 hook。盲区:存储表达式沿一跳取值这条在引擎 docblock 里写明、未找到逐行测试钉子(见前提 6)。
- **请回:** `A / B′`。

### 选项细节

**A — keep ruling A; the author-time refusal (#26655) stays.** The platform contract is as `filter.zod.ts:189-193` states it. hotclm's half, in platform-native form: a stored computed field on `clm_contract` — `review_sla_days: { type: 'number', expression: record.contract_type.review_sla_days }`. Per `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:3028-3040` (`planStoredExpressions`, #24619) a non-`formula` field with an `expression` has a column, is computed by the engine "on every write — the declared `expression` over the row the write stores", and is planned "with the `formula` read plan's own entry builder … so the scale rounding and the one hop are the read's"; both write paths wire `relatedFor: resolveFormulaRelated` (`engine.ts:14912`, `:16324-16330`). So the copy ruling `6415710193` item 6 asks for needs no hook: it is a declared field, recomputed on insert and on every update by id, and on a predicate update only when the patch moves `contract_type` (`field.zod.ts:1869`). The one business caveat: a change to `clm_contract_type.review_sla_days` reaches an existing contract on its next write, not immediately — which reads as "the SLA in force when the review started", a defensible SLA semantic, but it is a semantic and the card says so. The measure filter is then `review_started_at: { $lt: { $now: true, addDays: { $field: 'review_sla_days' } } }` with the column holding negative days, the spelling `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx:545-547` teaches.

**B′ — compile a to-one path offset.** Strategy (ii) of reading `6414128401`: the engine path (`driver-sql`) learns a one-hop `LEFT JOIN` for the *offset operand only* — `applyCrossFieldComparison` (`sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts:350-354`) and `applyNowAnchorComparison` (`:515-519`) resolve `a.b` through the declared `lookup` / `master_detail` field `a`'s `reference`, join that table on its primary key, and bind `COALESCE("a"."b", 0)` into `crossFieldOffsetExpr`. Enforcement stays in one place (the driver), so the 2026-08-12 rule's *reason* survives; what it reverses is the 2026-08-06 sentence "no JOIN planning, no alias contract" and the 2026-09-05 #15103 fallback ("capability unchanged … a dataset's `include` does not widen it", `query-syntax.mdx:589-595`). Strategy (i) — a cross-field compile branch inside `NativeSQLStrategy` riding ADR-0071's `qualifyAndRegisterJoin` — is not proposed: it is option A of the 2026-08-12 ruling, rejected there by name ("为无实测消费者的钩子建第二套枚举面"), and it would leave ordinary data filters refusing what dataset filters accept. Under B′ the spec (`filter.zod.ts:295-300` `AddDaysReferenceSchema` regex, `filter-comparand-type.ts:295-311` `dottedAddDaysOffset` / `dottedAddDaysOffsetRefusal`) narrows its refusal to two-or-more hops and to a first segment that is not a declared to-one field; the memory evaluator (`@objectstack/formula` `matches-filter.ts`) must either expand the hop or refuse, because today it reads a lookup's id on a stored row and counts zero days (PR #26655 body, "Executors measured"); `driver-mongodb` keeps refusing; `cross-field-conformance-cases.ts` gains the relation cells on both paths; `validate-filter-tokens` and the docs follow. Workload: one PR at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; per `6414128401` ≈ A + 300–500 source lines, 1.5–2× A, 4–5 dev-days; measured unit PR #26261 (+2587/−95, 35 files, merged 2026-10-26T19:11Z). No landed precedent for a join in either cross-field path — 「无先例」; the nearest measurement is #15103 → PR #15781, which measured the join chain and answered that it does not reach the `where` compilation.

**Why there is no third letter.** A declared `formula` field is virtual and cannot be the offset: `packages/spec/src/data/filter-cross-field-comparison-class.ts:145` lists `formula` in `CROSS_FIELD_NO_CLASS_REASONS` ("virtual: no stored column"). A `summary` roll-up aggregates children, and `clm_contract_type` is the parent. The stored-expression field above is the only platform-native route, and it is A's execution, not a new contract — so it is written under A rather than as C. The documented "stamp a due date" route is hotclm#31's letter C, declined there; not re-offered.

### Premises, each with its re-check

1. The dotted offset is refused at save and `os validate` — `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts | sed -n 295,300p` (regex `/^[^.]*$/` on `AddDaysReferenceSchema.$field`); `git grep -n 'dottedAddDaysOffset' origin/main -- packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-type.ts` → `:295`, `:415`. Holds.
2. Every SQL read refuses it — `git show origin/main:packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts | sed -n 350,354p` (pair offset), `| sed -n 515,519p` (now-anchor offset), `| sed -n 268,272p` (bare reference). Holds. (Seat ruling `6439436943` cited `:270`; that is the bare arm; the offset arms are `:350` and `:515` on this head.)
3. The native strategy declines every cross-field comparand so the engine path compiles it — `git grep -n 'findCrossFieldComparand' origin/main -- packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts` → `:38`, `:1063`, `:1084`; ruling quoted at `:666-672`. Holds.
4. The engine path has no join to ride — `git show origin/main:packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts | sed -n 1142,1162p` ("the engine cannot join in an aggregate"); `executeAggregate` carries no `include` (`include-relation-cross-field-boundary.test.ts:28-33`). Holds.
5. `Dataset.include` is to-one paths ≤3 hops — `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts | sed -n 595,606p`. Holds.
6. A stored expression on a non-`formula` field reads one hop at write time — `git show origin/main:packages/objectql/src/engine.ts | sed -n 3028,3040p`; `relatedFor` wired at `:14912` (insert) and `:16324-16330` (update). Docblock-stated; `engine-stored-expression-write.test.ts` carries no one-hop case (`git grep -n -i 'hop' origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/engine-stored-expression-write.test.ts` → 0 hits) → **the row-level behaviour is 「未验证」**; a dev on A's hotclm side verifies it with one record before relying on it.
7. hotclm's ask — `objectstack-ai/hotclm` is not attached to this session (REST 403), so the ask is cited as #26601 quotes it: nine contract types, `review_sla_days` ∈ {2, 3, 5, 10}, measured on @objectstack 18.2.0 from hotclm PR #168 as the head of legal; hotclm#31 ruling `6396322580` C. **「未验证」** against hotclm itself.

### The four axes

- **Long-term fit (≥50%).** Two years out, the platform's filter grammar should still be one closed rule an author can hold in one sentence: a comparand is a literal, a same-record column, or now, shifted by whole days held on the record. Salesforce reaches a parent's parameter through a cross-object formula field on the record, never through a filter that plans its own join, and SOQL's WHERE has no column arithmetic at all; Looker and Cube put a derived value in the model, not in the predicate. ObjectStack already has that shape — a stored computed field reading one hop (#24619 / #24197) — so A is the end-state, not a stopgap. B′ is the fourth time the same boundary is asked to move (2026-08-06, 2026-08-12, 2026-09-05, 2026-10-26), and each move so far was declined after measurement; taking it now opens a join contract inside the engine path that every later `$field` ask will cite. → A.
- **Business pull.** One consumer, hotclm, one column, measured only through #26601's quotes (premise 7). The maintainer's own ruling item 6 already gave hotclm its route; what B′ buys hotclm is "edit the SLA on the type and existing contracts follow at once" — a real but narrow gain, and arguably the wrong SLA semantic for reviews already underway. The pull does not clear the ≥3× workload gap the reading measured. → A, with the honest note that the 2026-09-05 facet ④ called "pushing a copy hop into every affected app" the expansion to refuse — the stored-expression route answers that objection without a hook or a second writer.
- **Guarding against AI-authored mistakes.** Today a dotted offset is refused loudly at save, validate and read, in one sentence (#26655). Under B′ the same spelling becomes legal for one hop and stays refused for two, and the memory evaluator must learn to expand the hop or an AI-authored filter answers silently wrong (zero days) on a stored row — the exact fault PR #26655 measured. A keeps the closed rule; B′ adds a conditional one. → A.
- **Startup-stage non-proliferation.** A adds no platform surface. B′ adds a permanent join obligation in `driver-sql` (or, under (i), a second cross-field compiler) plus the dual-path conformance it owes forever, for one app's one column. → A.

Self-check: 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 缩小特例——比较值规则仍是一句话(字面量、同记录列、或「现在」加本记录持有的天数),与 Salesforce 跨对象公式字段 + 报表过滤只读本记录的建模一致;B′ 在引擎路径新开一条 JOIN 契约,是同一边界第四次被要求移动。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天撞上的只有 hotclm 一个应用、一列(九种类型,2/3/5/10 天,引自 #26601,本会话无 hotclm 仓访问);裁决 6415710193 第 6 项已给出路,B′ 多买到的只是「类型上改 SLA 立即生效」。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 下带点偏移在保存、validate、读取三处同一句响亮拒绝(#26655);B′ 让一跳合法、两跳仍拒,且内存求值器若不展开关联就按 0 天静默算错——正是 #26655 实测到的故障。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 零新增平台面;B′ 给 driver-sql 加一条永久的 JOIN 义务(或原生策略第二套跨列编译)和双路径一致性测试,为一个应用的一列买单。

Prior rulings read: addDays dotted / $field JOIN same-table / $now anchor → 5 rulings read by id (6415710193, 6414128401, 5548479553, 5261751132, 6439436943) + #26601's dedupe (#25808, #26301); ADR-0021 D-C, ADR-0071; thread: #26601 6439436943 · full-text issue search unavailable in this session (`search/issues` 403, repo-bound) → unresolved.

### 裁后执行

- **A:** close this card `not_planned` citing this ruling; comment on #26601 that B′ was put to the maintainer and declined, so hotclm's answer is ruling `6415710193` item 6 in the stored-expression form above (a seat relays it to hotclm#31 / hotclm PR #168; the hotclm dev verifies premise 6 on one record first). No `objectstack` PR. Optional one-line follow-up for the skills lane: `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` names the stored-expression field as the way to hold a related value (governed surface, its own PR).
- **B′:** this card becomes the execution card — `domain:spec`, p2 (app-driven addition), `area:reports`; a new ruling line amends the 2026-08-06 sentence (one declared to-one hop for the offset operand, driver-planned, offset only) and the 2026-09-05 #15103 fallback; the seat dispatches one card thread at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER with `Ruling-ref:` naming the new comment; the dev verifies premises 1–4 first and reports a fork if any fails; ⛔ no second cross-field compiler in `NativeSQLStrategy`, ⛔ no two-hop, ⛔ no base-`$field` path (the bare `{ $lte: { $field: 'duty.due_on' } }` asymmetry stays its own question). The three governing texts above are rewritten in the same PR; `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/driver-sql` minor.

**Duplicate search.** `objectstack` issues read this round: #25808 (closed, ruling A), #26601 (closed, PR #26655), #15103 (closed, PR #15781), #7598 (closed, PR #7916), #14104 (closed, PR #15102). No open card asks for a path-valued `addDays` offset. Full-text search was not available to this session (see Prior rulings read).
